answer.rationale: The scenario involves a hazardous chemical being introduced into a work area for the first time, with employees decanting into workplace containers (requiring labeling) and lacking prior training on this new hazard. This is a HazCom scenario, not a PSM (highly hazardous chemical process) scenario, since no indication of PSM-threshold quantities or covered processes is given. The employer must have a written hazard communication program, ensure workplace containers are labeled, and provide training on the new chemical hazard before/at the time of introduction per §1910.1200(h)(1) and (h)(3).
